messages:
marina: Heads up — Brisbane (bne) regional edge will get staged traffic tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. Quick check: egress ACLs, DNS TTL, and data-residency for bucket writes — who's owning each? cc @net @infra :eyes:
josh: I can own egress ACLs. Will push rules before 08:30 UTC. Any special ports beyond 443/80?
li: DNS TTLs — we need 60s for the shift. @dns-team can we shorten to 60 by 07:45? Also change healthcheck to `/_health/bne`.
ben: Data residency: storage writes must stay in ap-southeast-3. I validated the bucket policy but need confirmation on CDN logs — will they land in S3 in-region or a centralized logstore?
marina: CDN logs -> should land in `bne-logs` bucket for now to avoid PII egress. Ben, can you update bucket policy? I'll open infra change: infra-changes#78.
josh: ACL PR: https://git.redwood/infra/acl/pulls/42 — ready for review @ben @li.
li: Reviewed, left one nit — TTL change needs a terraform var set. Pushing a tiny commit now.
deploy-bot: scheduled job `traffic-shift:bne` at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z (dry-run enabled).
marina: Cutover plan: 07:00 - preflight, 07:30 - smoke in staging, 08:30 - ACLs & routing config applied, 08:45 - DNS TTL to 60s, 09:00 - gradual shift 20% -> 100% over 30m, monitor errors/latency. Rollback if >5% error or latency spike >200ms.
ben: Will update bucket policy by 07:00 and confirm here.
li: Pushed tf var and applied to staging — quick smoke OK:
```
$ curl -s https://staging.bne-api.redwood.test/_health | jq
{"status":"ok","region":"bne"}
```
josh: I'll be oncall for the shift; monitoring radar + logs. Ping @josh for immediate alerts. :thumbsup:
marina: Thanks all — final go/no-go post at 08:50 UTC. :party_parrot:
